title: A tiny difference. The same rule.
prompt: Run the paired logistic recurrence. Change r and run again. Observe how the separation changes before choosing an interpretation.
hint: Compare r = 2.8 with r = 3.9. Read the exact definition below before making a universal claim.

conclusions.text: A separated pair proves the formal sensitivity condition for every point in the state space.
These runs record finite numerical separation for declared parameters; they do not establish all quantifiers in the definition.
Every small perturbation must grow at every step.

feedback.pass: You have reproducible observations. The universal sensitivity claim still requires a specified space, metric, and proof.
feedback.fail: Two trajectories test particular starts and times. The definition quantifies over every base point and every neighborhood.
